summary: Max Verstappen won the Belgian Grand Prix Sprint from P2 on the grid, 0.8s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Lando Norris completing the podium.
Lewis Hamilton made the biggest climb, from P18 to P15.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 9 points over Lando Norris.
